method: Each of the 15 final attempt_03 Poppler PNGs was individually opened and visually inspected using view_image.

pages.notes: Author, title, date, publication status, abstract and project-internal attribution are legible; no remaining spacing defect.
Opening two-test narrative and C6/source/receiver equations fit within margins; definitions remain readable.
Coaxial diagram distinguishes rim, disk center and displaced body probe. Angle/orientation labels, sign proof and one-sample corollary are clear.
Finite-radius geometry and curl/dipole equations fit; W/w and circle/body distinction are readable.
Coaxial table aligns and remains legible. Stokes/averaging statements and native source matrix do not clip.
Mean invariant, old-port null pair, WT qualification and minimum-storage formulas fit without collisions.
Tracking proposition, interjump witness, native map, tuple and boxed launch have intact symbols and equation numbers.
Signed work and boxed cost fit. Corrected offset reversal and offset-work formula are visible; receiver section begins cleanly.
Both figure panels remain legible at 90% width. The corrected sentence identifies the leading curl field at X. Equations 4.1–4.5 and the complete sign theorem fit together.
Saved numerical table and complete proof are readable. The theorem's sign sentence no longer continues after the table. Equations and sampling definition fit.
Zero pre-launch history is explicit before 4.15. Sampling bounds, equal latest delays, convexity proof and sufficient timing bounds are fully legible.
Scalar/rank-two limitation and actual WT paths are legible. The closing scope paragraph continues normally onto the next page.
Status table, updated provenance and complete differentiated-kernel proof are legible with intact formulas and page number.
Public evidence-access wording, crosswalk table and references 1–4 are legible; complete original archives are correctly identified as local.
References 5–10 and pinned-source links are clear; the final-page whitespace is intentional. No clipped footer or orphaned mathematical content.
